info.name: Mist Admins Orgs Stats - Devices API

params.name: type
params.description: Filter results by one device type. Use a single value; comma-separated values are not supported. enum: `all`, `ap`, `gateway`, `switch`

params.name: status
params.description: Filter results by status. enum: `all`, `connected`, `disconnected`. Accepts multiple comma-separated values.

params.name: site_id
params.description: Filter results by site identifier. Accepts multiple comma-separated values.

params.name: mac
params.description: Filter results by MAC address. Accepts multiple comma-separated values.

params.name: evpn_unused
params.description: If `evpn_unused`==`true`, find EVPN eligible switches which don’t belong to any EVPN Topology yet

params.name: fields
params.description: List of additional fields requests, comma separated, or `fields=*` for all of them

params.name: start
params.description: Lower bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d` or `-1w`

params.name: end
params.description: Upper bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d`, `-2h`, or `now`

params.name: duration
params.description: Time range duration for the query, using relative units such as `10m`, `7d`, or `2w`

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page

params.name: page
params.description: Select the page number to return when using page-based pagination; starts at `1`

items.docs:
Get List of Org Devices stats
This API renders some high-level device stats, pagination is assumed and returned in response header (as the response is an array)
